title: Change to the school day start time
audience: all families with students in grades 3-5
purpose: Tell families about a one-day change to the start time
action: Send students to school at 9:45 a.m. on the changed day
source_message: On Thursday, December 3, grades 3, 4, and 5 will start at 9:45 a.m. instead of 8:15 a.m. because of building maintenance. Bus routes will run on the normal schedule. Students should arrive by the new time; arriving later counts as a late arrival. If your child takes a bus, you do not need to do anything. If you drive your child, please plan for the later start. Questions? Call the school office at +1-555-0110.

expected_protected_items.value: If you take a bus, you do not need to do anything.

review_requirements: Confirm the two start times are different and in the right order in every language.
Confirm the bus exception is not read as a requirement to do nothing all day.
Fluent reviewer must confirm the tone stays reassuring rather than alarming.
